tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /snyan ngag me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam ngag gi 'dod 'jo zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

snyan ngag me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam bung ba'i rol rtsed ngag gi 'dod 'jo sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba rig pa'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// rab mdzes lang tsho ma rnying gsar pa chu shel kunda gangs ri dbang po'i mdzes pa 'phrog /rab snyan gsung dbyangs 'gyur khug stong gis ka la piṅka dri za rab dga'i rgyud mang 'gong*// rab gsal gting mtha' bral ba'i thugs mching lha lam gzhon nu chu gter che la 'khu zhing sdang*// rab mkhyen shes bya kun 'dom blo gros thogs med dga' ba ster mkhas 'jam mgon dpa' bor 'dud// shel dkar lcug phran ji bzhin dbyangs can sku// mu tig gzhon nu'i yal ga phyag gnyis kyi// 'dab stong me tog la 'gran phyag sor rtser// bung ba'i zlos gar rjes 'gro'i rol mo mkhan// dkar gsal kun phan zhal skyin rab mdzes shing*// smin legs dbang sngon thig le'i spyan zung dang*// shel phreng tshems dkar gzhon nu'i 'dzum zer gyis// bdag yid ku mud rgyas byed lha der 'dud// snyan ngag drug skyes rin chen du ma'i skor// mngon brjod mdzes byed brda dag tshar phreng can// don rgyan 'phel skyed srad bu la bstar ba// gzhon nu'i mgrin pa sgeg pa'i rgyan du spel// thos na rna ba'i padma rab g.yo zhing*// bsam na snying gi bung ba zlos gar sgyur// mthong na mig gi na chung 'dzum stong spel// rgyan gyi dam pa 'di ni cis mi sbyin// ci nas dbul por gyur kyang ni// mi 'gyur mdza' bo'i tshul mkhas shing*// rnam 'gyur g.yo dub mi mnga' ba'i// grogs bzang 'di yang skyes su sbyin// dang po rang bzhin brjod pa las rigs/ lang tsho rab tu 'khrul ba dang*// 'dzum phreng gsar pa'i 'jo sgeg mkhan// gnyis skyes gzhon nu mdzes pa de// bdag gi snying la ci yang rtsen// gnyis pa bya ba/ dkar dmar lang tsho 'khrugs pa'i 'dzum phreng dang*// rnam 'gyur stong phrag g.yo ba'i zur mig gis// bdag yid dga' bde'i dpal yon la rol ba// bag yod gzhon nu de ko ci zhig ko// gsum pa yon tan/

ma rnying lang tsho'i 'dzum dkar g.yo mkhas shing*// rnam dpyod zhi dul zur mig sgyu 'phrul can// 'khril ldem mdzes ldan gar mkhan khyod kyi tshul// gzhon nu stong phrag gtams kyang sgrun pa ci| |bzhi pa rdzas so/ mdzes pa gang gi bag yod gos// rnam gsum dmar ser rtags 'chang zhing*// 'o cag dpen pa'i rol rtsed mkhan// gzhon nu de ko gtol med do// ༈ /gnyis pa dpe rgyan las/ dang po chos dpe/ dkar 'jam lag pa'i zlos gar g.yo ba'i tshe// shel gyi lcug phran rlung gzhon gyis bskor bzhin| |rab dmar mchu yi lang tsho gsar pa yang*// 'dab stong can nyid rlan gyis brlan par 'khu// gnyis pa dngos dpe/ dkar gsal bzhin ras mdzes pa de// chu shel dbang po nyid la 'gong*| |'phrul byed mig gi na chung yang*// bung ba zung nyid lding bar snyam// gsum pa ldog pa/ khyod kyi lus bzhin ljon shing 'di rnams kyang*// bdag yid spu long g.yo ba'i zlos gar sgyur| |khyod kyi gdong 'gran zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yang*// dkar gsal mdzes pa'i lang tsho bdag la ngom// bzhi pa phan tshun/ lang tshos myos pa khyod kyi gdong*// utpa la ltar rab tu mdzes// chu skyes 'di yang khyod bzhin sdang*// rab mdzes dkar dmar dra bas sbrel// lnga pa nges pa/ gzhon nus lha rdzas thogs nas bdag cag la// myur bar 'dong zhes rnam 'gyur g.yab mo dang*// ljon pa 'di ko'i 'dab ma rlung gzhon nus// bskyod pa'i gzugs brnyan gzhan du mtshungs pa ci// drug pa nges med/ rab mdzes gzhon nu khyod kyi bzhin// lha dbang gzhon nur co 'dri ste// de lta'i mdzes pa gzhan yod na// dngos nyid de yi rjes su 'brang*// bdun pa bsdus pa/ gzhon nu khyod gdong dkar zhing gsal ba dang*// mig 'bras ri dwags mtshan pa kho nas kyang*// ku mud gnyen la rjes mthun min mod kyi// 'dzum phreng stong phrag bzhad pa des kyang ngo*// brgyad pa khyad par/

khyod gdong 'dzum phreng zer gyis bdag gi yid// mda' lngas myos pa de ko rtsad nas 'byin// 'dab brgya bzhad pa bung ba gzhon nu skyong*// 'di ni khyad par phra mo nyid du nges// dgu pa rab btags/ gzhon nu mdzes phyir kho bo la// rgyal zhes zla gzhon snyem mi dgos// 'chi med grong na brgya byin yang*// lang tsho brtas pa de yod phyir// bcu pa rmad byung*/ dkar dmar 'od mdangs 'khrugs pa'i 'dab brgya pa// ma rnying ze'u 'bru phreng bar spel ba la| |bdag yid 'phrog pa'i 'dzum ston g.yo ba na// bdag gis gzhon nu de la co 'dri zhes// bcu gcig pa rmongs pa/ thun mtshams dmar 'od 'khrugs pa'i dbus// rgyu skar rgyal po shar ba'i tshe| |dmar ser gos kyis rab bklubs pa'i// gzhon nu'i gdong zhes rmongs bdag g.yengs// bcu gnyis pa the tshom/ dbang po tshim byed bsad pa'i ro brgya 'di// sum rtsen dbang po'i bdud rtsi de ko dang*// gzhon nu mdzes pa'i ro 'dzin myangs pa dag /gang las byung snyam bdag yid som nyi za// bcu gsum pa rtogs pa/ ku mud brtan pa skyengs byed cing*// nyi ma'i zer gyis mi sgrib pa// 'di ni gzhon nu khyod kyi gdong*// yin gyi ri bong 'dzin pa min// bcu bzhi pa sbyar ba/ dkar gsal rnam 'gyur 'od brgya 'khrugs pa'i bzhin// thag ring bdag gi yid srub g.yo ba yis// gzhon nu mig gi dbang po gang gi gdong*// 'od dkar bdag po khyod dang phrag dog go// bco lnga pa mnyam nyid/ 'dzum phreng lang tsho bde ba'i bzhin ras kyis// rnam dpyod dga' ba'i dpal ster ro 'dzin dbang*// 'dab rgya bzhad pa'i ze'u 'bru'i gzugs brnyan nyid// tshim byed ro dag gzhib na bsod pa thob// bcu drug pa smad pa/ ngur smrig gyon yang rab blun cing*// ngag gis rig byed mi shes pa'i// ngang mo 'di dag gzhon nu dang*// kha dog mtshungs kyang khyad par che// bcu bdun pa bstod pa/

rin chen chu shel dbang po'i me long ngogs// padma rā ga'i dra bas sbrel ba dang*// bai ḍūr thig les mtshan pa zla med kyang*// gzhon nu'i gdong gi lang tshos skyengs par byas// bco brgyad pa rtog pa/ gnyis skyes khyod gdong padma ltar// dkar dmar bzhad pa'i dpal mtshungs zhes| |brjod 'dod 'di ni cir gyur kyang*// gna' dus nyid nas bdag gis rtog /bcu dgu pa 'gal ba/ ston gyi rgyu skar bdag po'i dkar 'tsher dang*// 'dam skyes lang tsho dar ba'i 'jo sgeg dang*// gzhon nu khyod gdong 'dzum phreng gsar pa 'di// phan tshun 'gal ba bzhin du bdag sems mo// nyi shu pa dgag pa/ dug can nang gi srog chags dag /ma rungs tshogs kyi gzugs nag nog /shar ba can gyi khyod gdong la// 'gran pa'i nus pa nam yang med// nyer gcig pa mdzes pa/ chu shel dngos las grub pa kun phan ma// ri dwags gzugs kyi lang tsho 'dzin byed kyang*// khyod gdong 'od dkar dang mtshungs ri dwags mig /mtshan mas spras pa 'di ko lhag par mdzes// nyer gnyis pa de nyid brjod pa/ mtshar sdug lang tsho gsar pa dang*// zlos gar bdag la g.yab mo dag /dbyar rnga'i na chung gar mkhan dang*// mu tig dkar po'i 'khri shing min// nyer gsum pa thun mong min pa/ sked skabs phra zhing sta zur legs ldem pa// shel dkar gzhon nu'i 'khri shing 'khyugs pa dang*// padma'i snal ma sogs kyis zla med phyir// khyod nyid sked skabs khyod kyis rnyed par 'gog /nyer bzhi pa byung min/ gzhon nu'i lang tsho rab dkar ba| |zla ba 'bum phrag legs bzhus pa'i// khu bas byugs pa dag gi steng*// byu ru'i mdangs kyis spras pa bzhin// nyer lnga pa srid min/ tsandan shing las mi gtsang dri ma dang*// btso ma'i gser las bung ba'i mdog ji bzhin// gzhon nu khyod kyi snying dang so sgo nas// khro ba'i sems dang mi snyan gtam 'byung ngam// nyer drug pa mang ba/

gzhon nu khyod gdong rab dkar ba// ri bong 'dzin dang gangs ri'i ngogs// ngang mo kunda 'o ma'i mtsho// shel dkar me long dpal 'phrog go// nyer bdun pa rnam 'gyur/ khyod gdong smin legs drang zhing 'khyogs pa yang*// ind+ra nī la'i khu bas bris pa ltar// rab dmar mchu yi ze'u 'bru gsar pa yang*// byu ru'i khu bas lan stong sbags par 'gong*// nyer brgyad pa phreng ba/ bde sogs kyis ni mig stong dang*// des kyang sum rtsen mdzes pa ltar// gzhon nu khyod kyi rol rtsed kyis// ngo cag yid kyi gdung ba sel// nyer dgu pa ngag don dang po mtshungs gsal gyi sgra gcig las med pa/ dmar ser bklubs pa'i steng du gzhon nu'i gdong*| |mthong byed mig gi lang tsho ngom pa de// thun mtshams sprin gzhon stong gi 'od dkar can// ri dwags mtshan ma'i lang tsho g.yo ba sdang*// sum cu pa ngag don mtshungs gsal du ma yod pa/ gzhon nu'i bzhin dkyil zla ba ltar// bsil zer rjes 'gro 'dzum phreng gi// ku mu ta ltar bdag gi yid// 'dab stong rgyas 'gran dga' bde 'phel// so gcig pa zla bo dngos po/ nor ldan ma 'di gzhon nu yod dgu'i dbus// gnyis skyes mdzes par 'gran nus yod sems sam// rgyu skar bgrang yas tshar du dngar ba'i dbus// kun phan nyid la 'gran par nus yod dam// so gnyis pa mtshungs sbyor/ bde sogs lha dbang drung na mdzes// gzhon nu bdag gi mdun na ste// de yi dbang po'i dga' bde dang*// gnyis skyes des kyang bdag yid tshim// so gsum pa rgyu dpe rnams so/ lhag par gces pa'i gzhon nu mdza' na de// bdag la mdza' bas ma dang skyong phyir pha// mi 'bral snying dang rab gces mthong ba'i mig /duḥkha sel byed sman pa nyid dang mtshungs| ༈ /gsum pa gzugs can gyi rgyan las/ dang po bsdus pa'i gzugs can ni/ gnyis skyes khyod gdong zla ba ste// ri dwags gzugs mdzes lang tsho bzhad// 'dzum phreng 'od dkar 'phro mkhas pa// bdag yid kunda dga' bar byed// gnyis pa ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/

gzhon nu'i gdong gi gangs ri'i dbang po las// bzhad pa'i 'dzum phreng dal 'gro'i rgyun mang de// bab tshe bdag blo'i chu skyes gsar pa'i gzugs// lang tsho'i rnam 'gyur phyogs brgyar g.yo bar byed// gsum pa bsdus shing ma bsdus pa'i gzugs can/ mu tig 'khri shing khyod yan lag /mdzes byed rnam 'gyur rlung bskyod pa// kun nas g.yo zhing bde ba'i brda// phyogs brgyar bsgyur yang bdag la mtshon// bzhi pa mtha' dag /khyod gdong pad tshal rgyas pa'i nor ldan mar// mthong byed utpal sngon po'i 'jo sgeg ma// bdag yid bung ba'i 'phur lding rol rtsed kyis// tshim byed sbrang rtsi'i ro ldan ci yang thob// lnga pa cha shas/ so phreng chu shel dum bu'i 'dzum 'od dang*// mig dag dbang sngon thig le'i mdzes sdug can| |sna tshogs gar gyi rol mkhas gzugs can des// bdag yid myos pas bltas kyang tshim ma gyur// drug pa cha shas can/ drang zhing 'khyog ldan phra ba'i sked skabs can// khyod lus dpag bsam sā la'i ljon pa dag /'phrul mthing mig dang dkar gsal so yi phreng*// dmar snum mchu sgros smin legs kun gyis mdzes// bdun pa yan lag gcig pa/ gzhon nu'i lang tsho ma rnying gsar pa'i bzhin// dkar 'tsher so yi phreng ba spel legs shing*// zur mig khu byug gzhon nu'i rol gar des// bdag yid mya ngan med par tshim par byas// brgyad pa ldan pa/ gnyis skyes lag pa'i 'khri shing dbang po'i rtser// bzhin ras 'dab brgya g.yo ba'i lang tsho dang*// so phreng me tog dkar pos nyer mdzes par// mig ni rma bya gzhon nus bro gar brdung*// dgu pa ldan min/ bzhin ras chu shel dbang po'i sgeg 'chang ma// dkyus ring mig gi mthon mthing 'dzum bzhin du// smin legs 'khri shing g.yo ba'i zur mig gi// skar mda' 'phangs pas bdag nyid kun nas rtsen// bcu pa mi mnyam pa/ rab dkar so yi phreng bas mdzes// rnam par dmar ba'i mchu sgros can// 'byes pa lag pa'i 'khri shing zung*// rma bya'i 'gros kyi gar mkhan ma| |bcu gcig pa khyad par/

gnyis skyes spa ba'i phub chung rab bkra ba// 'dzum phreng mig gi snam logs nyag phran de// bdag snying 'ben la reg cing bsnun de ko// 'jab kyi 'chi med lo brgyar 'tsho bar byas// bcu gnyis pa 'gal gzugs/ khyod gdong nam mkha'i nor bu'i zer phreng gis// pad dkar 'dab brgya bzhad dang mun sel dang*// zlum po'i lam du nam yang mi 'gro bar// bdag yid 'chums pa'i tsha gdung brtad de bcom// bcu gsum pa rgyu'i gzugs/ khyod gdong dkar bas zla ba'i rang bzhin dang*// 'dzum phreng stong ldan lha dbang sras nyid dang*// mdzes shing rab sgeg rma bya gzhon nu dang*// snyan par smra bas ngag dbang sgra snyan nyid// bcu bzhi pa sbyar gzugs/ na chung mdzes pa'i lang tsho 'dab brgya pa// bzhad pa'i 'dzum phreng rkang drug bdag cag snying*// rma kha tshim byed 'dod pa'i yon tan dang*// kun gyi yid srub gsar pa deng nas brtas// bco lnga pa dpe gzugs/ 'jo sgeg rol pa'i rnam 'gyur stong phrag dang*// smin legs mig gi 'dzum phreng rab g.yo ba'i| |gzhon nu rma bya'i zlos gar bdag po des// lha yi gar mkhan mang po'i dpal yon phrogs// bcu drug pa ldog pa can gzugs/ mdzes pa'i ro 'dzin sbrang rtsis bdag tshims shing*// pad dkar bcud kyis rkang drug gzhon nu tsho// khyod kyi ro 'dzin nyer 'tshes rab dben zhing*// sbrang rtsi'i ro nyid skye bo'i tshogs kyis 'joms// bcu bdun pa 'gog pa/ khyod gdong tsandan dpal phreng las// 'dzum 'od ga pur gsar pa'i thigs phreng gis// bdag yid tsha ba'i gdung ba kun 'bar na// man shel stag gzig ga pur ci phyir yin// bco brgyad pa mnyam 'jog /gnyis skyes rkang 'thung dbang po'i rol rtsed dang*// dga' spro gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng dri bzhon gyis// bdag yid sred pa'i mya ngan khang bur nyal// gna' nas nyon mongs nyes pa'i skyon du shes// bcu dgu pa gzugs can gyi gzugs can/

khyod gdong 'dab brgya bzhad pa'i dga' tshal du// mig gi bung ba lha yi gar mkhan des// zur mig 'phur lding gar gyi rol rtsed kyis// bdag snying khu byug dga' ma'i dga' ston bgyis// nyi shu pa bsnyon dor gzugs can rnams so/ rab mdzes 'di ko khyod min lha'i gnyis skyes// mthing 'khyog smin ma min mod dbang sngon gzhu// dkar 'tsher so phreng ma yin gangs ri'i phreng*// snyan tshig khyod ngag min mod lha'i rol mo/ ༈ /bzhi pa gsal byed las/ dang po rigs brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ gnyis skyes mdzes pa gzhon nu dag /'dzum phreng du ma'i tshogs spel zhing*// dga' bde'i rol pa kun mnga' ba// yid 'ong lang tsho mdzes pa yang*// gnyis pa bya ba brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ rtag par 'jug go bdag yid mtshor// gnyis skyes ngang mo gzhon nu ko// mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan sgrog cing*// dga' spro'i zlos gar sgyur bzhin du// gsum pa yon tan brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ mngon par tshim mo gzhon nu kwa// legs par 'grogs pa'i 'khril sbyor dang*// srid bde'i rang bzhin rol rtsed kyis// yid srub rnam 'gyur g.yo bas kyang*// bzhi pa rdzas brjod pa thog ma'i gsal byed/ legs par mdzes so yid kyi grogs// gzhon nu khyod lus gur gum dang*// padma rā ga'i mdangs ldan pa'i// bka' rtags rnam gsum dag gis brgyan// lnga pa rigs par/ bdag yid mdza' ba'i grogs po dag /'dzum phreng g.yo ba'i gnyis skyes dbang*| |lang tsho ma rnying gsar pa dang*// mchu yi rtsed 'jo ci yang bsgyur// drug pa bya bar/ mdzes ldan khyod gdong 'dzum 'od kyis// bdag nyid myos pa'i dpal du byas// dal gyis gtams pa'i chu gter gyis// ngang mo'i 'dus pa 'di ko rnams// bdun pa rigs mtha'/ lang tshos myos pa'i bzhin ras can// dkar 'tsher phreng ba dngar ba'i so// dmar zhing snum pa'i mchu sgros 'chang*| |bdag nyid dga' ba'i gnyis skyes nyid// brgyad pa bya ba mtha'/

tsha zer can gyis rab bskyangs pa'i// padma yis ni bung ba dang*// gzhon nu'i 'dzum phreng 'jo sgeg gis// bdag snying dga' ba'i dpal mor byas// dgu pa phreng ba/ dbang sngon mdangs kyi zur mig dang*// des kyang smin legs des bzhin ras// de yis 'jo sgeg rol pa'i lus// de yi gar gyis bdag yid spro| |bcu pa 'gal don/ gnyis skyes khyod gdong 'dzum phreng gi// dpal mo gsar pa'i sgyu ma mkhan// mthong tshe bral ba'i gdung ba dag /phrogs nas dga' bde'i myos byed sbyin// bcu gcig pa don gcig pa/ mngon 'dod gsar pa'i nor sbyin zhing*// myos pa'i tsha gdung sel ba dang*// yid srub dga' ba'i dpal yon rnams// mchu sgros gsar pa'i reg bya sbyin// bcu gnyis pa sbyar ba'i gsal byed rnams so// rab dkar gsal zhing 'tsher ba dang*// g.yo ba'i rnam 'gyur 'bum ston pa// chu 'dzin mkha' dang tsha gdung skyob// gnyis skyes 'dir gnas bdag yid tshim/ ༈ /lnga pa bskor ba can gyi rgyan las/ dang po don bskor ba ni/ gnyis skyes khyod mthong mig la bdud rtsi rgyas// ngag 'jam tshig gis rna ba'i bcud len spel// ro 'dzin gzhibs pas sems kyi kun dga' brtas// 'khyud sbyor rol pas dga' bde'i dpal yon 'phel// gnyis pa tshig bskor/ 'od dkar stong phrag bzhad pa'i lding khang du// ri dwags gzugs kyi lang tsho'i zlos gar sgyur// gnyis skyes khyod gdong mdzes pa'i lding khang du// mig gi na chung 'phrul mthing zlos gar sgyur// gsum pa gnyis ka bskor ba/ khyod gdong 'dzum 'od gsar pa'i rol rtsed kyis// bdag gi mthong byed tshim pa'i mngon 'dod thob// 'khril ldan lus kyi reg bya'i rol rtsed kyis// bdag nyid dga' bdes tshim pa'i mngon 'dod thob/ ༈ /drug pa 'gog rgyan las/ dang po byung ba 'gog pa ni/ gzhon nu'i rtse dgas nyan thos kyi// dka' thub bzlog pa 'di ko ci// 'on kyang me tog dag gi mdas// snying la ma bsnun sa steng su// gnyis pa mngon gyur 'gog pa/

gnyis skyes khyod lus thun mtshams kyi// sprin gzhon bgo bas ci zhig bgyi// kun gyi yid rab phrogs pa yi// 'dzum 'od bde bas bdag yid rtsen// gsum pa 'byung 'gyur 'gog pa/ gzhon nu bdag cag lang tsho ni// brtas tshe khyod yid gcugs gyur kyang*// mgo skyes shar gyi thig le'i mdangs// 'gong tshe bdag la mdza' mi 'gyur// bzhi pa chos 'gog/ khyod gdong 'dzum sgeg bdud rtsi 'di// dga' skyed mig ni bcud len rdzun// de nyid mthong bas bdag gi snying*// 'dod pa'i dug gis khyab par zin// lnga pa chos can 'gog pa/ lha yi gnyis skyes khyod kyi lus// mdzes sogs rnam dbye su yis 'byed| |thun mtshams gzhon nu'i lding khang du// 'dzum mdangs g.yo las gzhan ma mthong*// drug pa rgyu 'gog pa/ lus phra snying du sdug pa khyod// dga' bde'i rtse dga' brgya ston yang*// chags bral lnga rig sdom brtson bdag /ba spu'i rtse yang g.yo mi mnga'// bdun pa 'bras bu 'gog pa/ gnyis skyes khyod kyi 'jo sgeg dang*// yid srub rtse dga'i rnam 'gyur dang*// lhan cig 'grogs kyang bdag gi yid// chags pa'i chos kyis gos ma gyur// brgyad pa rjes gnang 'gog pa/ gzhon nu khyod cag yul gzhan du// bgrod par 'dod na deng song zhig /khyod dang bral ba'i sred ldan yang*// yun ring gdung bar dogs mi 'tshal// dgu pa dbang gis 'gog pa/ rang yul bde ba'i dpal thob cing*// nor dang longs spyod dag gis phyug /bshul lam bde skyid ldan mod kyang*// yul gzhan bgrod par mi 'tshal lo// bcu pa ma gus pa'i 'gog pa/ ngo cag srog ldan 'dun pa bdog /sgyu ma'i nor rdzas 'dun pa med// gnyis skyes 'gro'am 'dug gyur kyang*// dngos po'i gnas lugs de kho na// bcu gcig pa brjod pa 'gog pa/ gzhon nu gzhan du bgrod pa na// lam du bde ba'i dpal thob cing*// bdag kyang phyi ma'i dus kyi tshe// khyod kyi gan du phyin par mos// bcu gnyis pa rtsub mos 'gog pa/

khyod nyid gzhan du 'gro ba na// gnyis skyes gzhan zhig myur du 'tshol// bdag cag da lta srog dor na// khyod kyi lhag bsam des 'grub bam| |bcu gsum pa grogs kyis 'gog pa/ khyod nyid yul gzhan bgrod 'dod na// song zhig bdag cag gum pa'i tshe// nye 'brel gdung ba'i cho nge yis// khyod snying rtsen pa nyid du 'gyur// bcu bzhi pa 'bod pa 'gog pa/ song zhes khyod 'dod sgrub pa'i tshig /brjod par 'dod kyang ma 'gro zhes// bdag yid zhe 'dod kho na'i tshig /sngon chad kha nas mang du thal// bco lnga pa gzhan dbang 'gog pa/ skad cig mig dang bral na yang*// sems kyi nyes pa bskyed pa khyod// yul gzhan 'gro bar 'dod pa na// bdag yid de yi khol por gyur// bcu drug pa thabs kyis 'gog pa/ mdza' bo bral ba'i mya ngan dag /bdag gis bzod kyi bdag cag la// mgrin pa sgeg pa'i rgyan dag tu// shar gyi thig le myur stsol cig /bcu bdun pa khro bas 'gog pa/ grogs khyod bgrod par 'dod pa'i tshig /mdza' bas ma bcings sgras zin no// bco brgyad pa mya ngan gyis 'gog pa/ da ni 'gro'am sdod kyang rung*// bdag yid mya ngan khur khyer cing*// cho nge drag pos mgrin 'gags pa'i// ldab ldib smra ba snying rje'i yul// bcu dgu pa 'gyod pas 'gog pa/ khyod nyid gzhan du myur deng na// yid srub dga' bde'i rol rtsed kyi// bro gar gna' nas ma brdungs pa// bdag snying 'gyod pa'i mda' yis rtsen// nyi shu pa the tshom gyis 'gog pa/ dngul dkar gyi ni me long dang*// bdud rtsi'i 'od dang gnyis skyes gdong*// gang zhes tshom yang 'dzum mdangs kyis// gnyis skyes khyod gdong yin par nges// nyer gcig pa sbyar ba'i 'gog pa/ rnam 'gyur stong phrag rab g.yo zhing*// 'jo sgeg gsar pa'i ngang 'dzum gyis// gnyis skyes gar mkhan de mthong tshe// lha yi gar mkhan ngo mtshar bral// nyer gnyis pa don gzhan 'gog pa/

lus phra khyod dang rab brtses pas// bdag yid tshim pa med 'di mtshar// 'on kyang rkang drug gzhon nu yis// sbrang rtsi btungs kyang yongs mi tshim| |nyer gsum pa rgyus 'gog pa/ gnyis skyes khyod ni bdag cag la// lhag par sems zhes ma bstod kyang*// khyod dang bdag lus tha dad tsam// yin gyi sems dag dbye ru med/ ༈ /bdun pa don gzhan bkod pa'i rgyan las/ dang po kun khyab don gzhan bkod pa/ rol sgeg nyams brgya'i 'gyur bag stong g.yo ba'i// rnam rtsen gzhon nu de ni yi gar 'ong*// lang tsho gsar pa'i ngang tshul 'dzum dga' dang*| |mdzes sdug can des yid srub mi ldang su// gnyis pa khyad par la gnas pa/ mi gtsang rdzas kyis rab gang bzhin legs kyi// gnyis skyes des ni bdag yid dpal yon sbyin// mi gtsang 'dam du skyes pa'i 'dab brgya nyid// zhing mchog dam pa rnams kyi spyan sngar mdzes// gsum pa sbyar ba/ rnam dpyod rgyu skar bdag po'i bzhin ras can// gnyis skyes ma des bdag snying mig tshim byed| |ke sa ra dang ldan pa'i lus phras kyang*// kun gyi mig dang snying la bdud rtsi spel// bzhi pa 'gal ba/ gang yang 'dus byas sgyu ma'i gzha' tshon la// gnyis skyes 'dzum mdangs gsar pas bdag snying brlams// longs pas dug gi chu rgyun ro bda' yang*// nyam nga mi bzad drag po skyed pa'i rgyu// lnga pa mi 'os pa/ khyod gdong dga' ba'i 'dzum brjid du ma dang*// 'khyud sbyor khyad par gzhol yang slad nas kwe// yid srub rtsab hral phyogs brgyar rab spyom pa// 'o cag sdig ldan 'di ko byab mang ngo*// drug pa 'os pa/ gzugs bzang lto ba phra ba'i rnam 'gyur can// gzhon nus reg pas bdag yid myos pa dag /'di ko mi rigs nyid min dug can gyi// 'khyog 'gro'i lus ltar ldem pa de nyid phyir// bdun pa 'os shing mi 'os pa/ dpal mos yid srub gsar pa brtas byed kyang*// gnyis skyes khyod kyis ci slad rā ga nas// mdzes ma rnams kyi chos de gzhon nu yis// bdag la ci phyir stsol ba bgyir med do// brgyad pa mi 'os shing 'os pa rnams so// gnyis skyes gzur gnas khyod kyis bdag bslu na// ri yi sras mos ci phyir bdag mi bslu// sbrang rtsi'i bcud kyis bdag srog rab 'gum na// dug can zas kyis lnga par cis mi 'gyur/

༈ /brgyad pa ldog pa can gyi rgyan las/ dang po gcig gi ldog pa can/ dmar ser mdzes pa'i lhab lhub dang*// ngag snyan mgrin pa'i rdza rnga 'dis// khyod dang ngang mo phrag dog kyang*// blo gros ldan pas tha dad do// gnyis pa gnyis ka'i ldog pa/ khyod lus shar gyi thig le dang*// dkar ba'i rnam pas rjes su 'gro// 'on kyang khyod gdong 'dzum stong dang*// zla gzhon bsil zer spel bas so// gsum pa sbyar ba/ mdzes ldan khyod yid zab pa dang*// gting dpag dka' bas dug can nyid// mtshungs mod 'on kyang yon tan gyis// shes bya bzlums pas de yang min// bzhi pa 'gog pa/ brtan cing g.yo ba mi mnga' yang*// kumbhi ra yis rab gang ba'i// zla bas 'phel 'di khyod yid dang*// rjes su byed pa nam yang med// lnga pa gtan tshig /gnyis skyes khyod gdong tshos kyi bdag /dkar gsal 'od kyis rab brtas kyang*// spyang kis za phyir khyod gdong las// rgyu skar bdag po dman pa nyid// drug pa dbye ba/ khyod kyi lus phra 'di ko dang*// so ga'i 'khri shing gzhon nu'i khyad// khyod lus mngal gyis bskyed pa ste// rkang thung nor ldan ma las thon// bdun pa lhag pa/ gdengs can khyim la bag yod dang*// brtul phod blo gros bde ba dang*// bdag la mdza' ba'i sems med kyi// de dag rnams kyis khyod yid phyug /brgyad pa sgra mtshungs/ khyod kyi gdong dang 'o ma'i mtsho// dkar 'tsher g.yo bas yid 'dren yang*// khyod gdong 'dzum dga'i zur mig dang*// 'o mtsho 'dab brgya tshar du dngar// dgu pa rtogs mtshungs/ khyod gdong 'dzum dkar bdud rtsi dang*// rgyu skar bdag po'i bsil zer phreng*// zla bas rgyas pa ku mud dang*// khyod bzhin 'dzum gyis bdag yid dpal// bcu pa rigs mthun ldog pa rnams so// zla ba'i zer dang ga pur gyi// reg byas bsil bar mi byed par// bdag gis khyod bzhin mthong ba'i mod// yid srub tshad gdung kun nas 'bar/

༈ /dgu pa srid pa can las/ dang po 'jig rten la grags pa'i rgyu ldog pa'i srid pa can/ ma phyis dri ma kun bral khyod gdong mdzes// pir gyis bris pa min yang smin ris bkra// ma gzhibs mngar ba'i ro ldan mchu sgros dmar// bsam pa min yang khyod nyid snying la rtsen// gnyis pa rgyu gzhan cung zad ldog pa/ 'o mtshor ma bkrus khyod gdong dkar ba'i mdangs// bai ḍūr bong ba min yang 'phrul mthing mig /nal gyis sbags pa min yang mchu sgros dmar// gna' nas 'dris pa med kyang snying gi grogs// gsum pa rang gi ngo bo tsam ston pa srid pa can rnams so// rgyu mtshan med par bdag la mdza' tshugs shing*// ma 'dris par yang shin tu bag phab nas// bdag la snying gros lhug por stsol ba yi// gnyis skyes gzhon nu dran pas bdag sems skyo/ ༈ /bcu pa bsdus brjod las/ dang po khyad gzhi khyad chos gnyis ka tha dad kyi bsdus brjod ni/ bdag cag gces pa'i nor dag tu// sna tshogs rin chen du ma'i dkor// 'bad pa kho nas mi bskrun par// chu yi dbu ba'i nor dag 'tshol// gnyis pa khyad gzhi tha dad la khyad chos mtshungs pa/ 'dod pa 'phel zhing dga' skyed nyid// lan brgyar gzhibs kyang mi tshim pa'i// sbrang rtsi dag gi ro 'di kwo// bdag yid 'bar zhing gdung ba'i rgyu// gsum pa khyad gzhi gcig la khyad chos tha dad pa'i bsdus brjod/ thun mtshams gos kyis bklubs pa'i steng*// dkar gsal mdzes pa'i 'od phreng can// ri bong gzugs kyi lang tsho brtas// zla ba gzhon nu bdag gi grogs// bzhi pa sngon med bsdus brjod rnams so// 'dam skyes 'dam gyis ma gos shing*// bhra ma raḥdang mi rtse ba'i// sngon med 'dab brgya bzhad pa de// dran pas bdag yid myos par byas/ ༈ /bcu gcig pa phul byung gyi rgyan las/ dang po khyad 'phags phul byung*/ bag ldan gnyis skyes gzhon nu'i sked skabs dag /phra ldem drang zhing 'dril ba'i zlos gar 'di| |mu tig 'khri shing gzhon nu'i 'jo sgeg dang*// rnam par dbye ba med pa 'di kho na// gnyis pa the tshom/

khyod gdong dkar gsal mdzes pa'i do ra der// 'dzum phreng stong phrag bzhad pa'i pad tshal du// mdzes sdug mig gi gar mkhan yod dam med// da dung bdag gi the tshom zlog ma gyur// gsum pa nges pa/ yid 'ong khyod bzhin gsal dwangs mkha' lam du// mthong byed mig gi zla ba yod ces nus// bdag la dga' ba'i rnam 'gyur rab ston pa'i// zur mig g.yo de gzhan du ga la yod// bzhi pa grags pa phul byung rnams so// lo stong bltas kyang cung zad mi tshim pa'i// gnyis skyes bzhin ras mtshar sdug de mthong tshe// yid srub dga' bas lnga par mi 'gyur ba// e ma de dag rdo rje'i sku yin nam/ ༈ /rab rtog gi rgyan las/ dang po sems ldan rab rtog /khyod kyi mchu sgros dmar zhing 'dzum// so phreng gsar pa ngom pa 'di// bdag yid mngon 'dod gsar pa yis// myos pas tsumba na 'dod snyam// gnyis pa sems med/ khyod gdong dkar gsal mdzes mthong bas| |chu shel dbang po yid zhum ste// mya ngan khang bur 'gre ldog cing*// ngus pa'i mchi ma mtsho ltar 'khyil// gsum pa bzhin sgra can/ khyod lus phra zhing ldem pa dang*// bdag la 'jo sgeg ston pa bzhin// 'phrul bzhad mig gi rol gar 'di// bdag la zur mig 'bod pa bzhin// bzhi pa gsal byed snyam sgra can/ khyod gdong 'phrul mthing rol rtsed kyis// bung ba skyengs nas lding bar snyam// kha sgo'i ze'u 'bru mtshar sdug pas// pad dkar zhum ste zum par snyam// lnga pa dogs sgra can/ khyod gdong dkar ba'i zer phreng gis// zla ba skyengs nas nub kyi dogs| |ngag snyan 'di yis rab dga' ste// sgyid lug pi wang bor gyi dogs// drug pa nges sgra can/ khyod gdong mdzes pas lha dbang yang*// mig stong phye nas lta bar nges// zur mig 'dzum pas pad dkar yang*// skyengs nas nags su bros par nges// bdun pa 'dra ba'i sgra can/ khyod lus phra ba'i rol rtsed la// lcug phran 'gran 'dod g.yo ba 'dra// 'dren byed na chung gar mkhan la'ang*| |rma bya 'gran 'dod rtse ba 'dra// brgyad pa min nam sgra can rnams so// khyod gdong dkar ba'i mdangs ldan 'di// bde sogs kyis ni lha dbang gi// bzhin gyi dkyil 'khor dang nor te// dri bzang chu yis bkrus min nam/

༈ /bcu gsum pa rgyu yi rgyan las/ dang po skyed byed kyi rgyu/ rab mdzes gnyis skyes gzhon nu'i bzhin ras kyi// dkar dmar 'khrugs pa'i rnam 'gyur stong g.yo zhing*// dmar ba'i mchu sgros 'phrul byed zur mig de// bdag cag yid srub mngon 'dod rgyas par byed// gnyis pa gsal byed/ gzhon nu dang ni lhan cig rtse ba 'di// lhag ma dang po skyed pa'i rgyu yin zhes| |'dul mngon mdo lung rnams nas bshad mthong bas// bdag yid 'dod pa'i tsha gdung nyams par byas// gsum pa rnam 'gyur gyi rgyu/ gzhon nu khyod gdong rab mdzes 'dzum pa'i phreng*// brgya phrag rnam 'gyur g.yo ba de mthong tshe// btsun por rlom pa'i gnyis skyes kha cig kyang*// mngon 'dod gsar pa nyid du ldog par 'gyur// bzhi pa thob byed/ dbang po gnyis sprod dngos po'i bde ba dag /nam yang thob pa'i cha shas mi bdog kyang*// sen mo 'debs shing dga' ba'i tsumba nas/ spu long g.yo ba'i chags bde'i bdud rtsi thob// lnga pa phyi'i shes byed/ ku mud dgod cing padma rab zum dang*// bya dang bung ba'i 'phur lding dang bral tshe// gzhon nu khyod kyang bdag khyim bde ba'i sar// yid srub rtse ba'i slad du dongs 'tshal lo// drug pa nang gi shes byed/ dga' ba rab bskyed gzhon nu khyod mthong bas// bdag lus tsandan chu dang ga pu ras// bsil bar nus pa med pa'i drod 'bar zhing*// bzhin ras rab dmar spu long g.yo bar byas// bdun pa snga na med pa/ rgya mtsho'i ska rags can 'dir rnyed dka' ba'i// gzhon nu khyod dang gna' nas ma phrad pas// bdag cag gzhon nu nyi tshe'i grogs gzhan la// dga' ba'i dpal mor byas pas mnar bar gyur// brgyad pa zhig nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ 'dod sred nyon mongs nyes pa'i tshogs dran pas// bdag yid dga' bde'i 'dun pa la rol ba'i// gzhon nu rnams la rtse dgar longs spyad pa// de ni spangs te sems la zhi ba thob// dgu pa phan tshun med pa'i rgyu/

gnyis skyes khyod lus sems la rab dran pa// bsam gtan ma yin khyod ming yang nas yang*// brjod pa 'di ko gsang sngags bzlas brjod min// de phyir bdag yid kun nas bsad par gyur// bcu pa spangs nas med pa'i byed rgyu/ mi legs bag yangs phal pa'i gzhon nu yi// rnam dpyod bya rog grong khyer spyod pa 'dra'i// gshis lugs med phyir bdag yid khyod tshul la// dga' ba 'bum phrag bskal brgya'i bar du 'phel// bcu gcig pa zlog pa skyed byed rgyu// gnyis skyes me tog mda' yi bya ma rta| |khyod dang 'grogs pas bdag yid tshim med par// rtag tu yid srub gzhogs stegs gsar pa yis// 'chal tshul spu long g.yo las duḥkha 'phel// bcu gnyis pa ring 'bras kyi rgyu/ gnyis skyes bzur 'dug 'jo sgeg gnam ru las// drangs pa'i zur mig nyag phran rab 'bad pas// rang gi mdza' tshugs snying la rtsen byas nas// thag ring chags ldan kun yid 'ben la bsnun// bcu gsum pa dus mnyam/ gnyis skyes khyod lus dkar 'jam phra ldem zhing*// lang tsho shin tu bde ba'i reg bya la// tsumba na dang 'khyud sbyor bde ba'i rgyu// kunda 'bras bu mngar ba dus mnyam byas// bcu bzhi pa 'bras bu snga ba/ khyod gdong pad dkar 'dab brgya bzhad pa las// so phreng ze'u 'bru 'dzum mdangs ma mthong ba'i// snga rol nyid nas de dag dran tsam gyis// bdag yid bung ba dga' bde'i sbrang rtsis myos// bco lnga pa mi rigs pa/ gnyis skyes tsandan bsil ba'i ljon shing gi// yan lag lcug phran gzhon nus 'khyud tsam nas// bdag yid 'dod pa'i tshad snying gdung ba dag /gcong nad dam pos zin pa 'di ko ci// bcu drug pa rigs pa rnams so// lang tsho rab rgyas dkar 'jam dri bsod pa'i// yid 'ong sha yi me tog khyod mthong tshe// bdag yid srub pa'i rkang drug mdza' na mo// dga' ba'i rol gar kun nas bsgyur la dbang*/

༈ /bcu bzhi pa phra mo'i rgyan las/ dang po zur gyi phra mo/ khyod dang 'u cag chags so zhes// tshogs su smra ba ma bzod kyang*// tshig snyan yi ge'i star drangs nas// tshig phrad zur gyis bshad 'di mtshar// gnyis pa rnam pa'i phra mo'o/ yu bu cag gi yid srub kyi// mngon 'dod gsar pa'i 'jo sgeg dag /gnyis skyes khyod kyis mthong ma thag /bzhin ras dmar ba'i mdangs kyis mdzes/ ༈ /bco lnga pa cha'i rgyan las/ dang po rang bzhin gsal po bsgribs pa/ gnyis skyes na ra'i me tog gsar pa de// dran tshe myos pas sems stor bzhin bsdus shing*// mig mi 'dzum pa'i rol rtsed gsar pa de// tshig rgyan phra mo'i rig pa yin par shes// gnyis pa cha la smad pa/ bdag yid sdug pa'i gnyis skyes lus phra khyod// 'dzum sgeg rnam 'gyur stong phrag rol rtsed kyis// bag yod khrims ldan rnams kyang yid srub pa// bde sogs kun las mdzes pa e ma mtshar// gsum pa cha la bstod pa rnams so// thag ring bgrod na yid kyi zhags pa nyid// mig gis mthong na chags pa'i phrag dog ldang*// nye bar 'grogs na 'dod pa'i dug gis zin// ji ltar byas kyang gnyis skyes bdag gi dgra/ ༈ /bcu drug pa rim pa can gyi rgyan gcig go// khyod gdong dkar gsal 'od kyis mdzes// mchu sgros dmar ba'i 'dzum mdangs can// dung dang ston zla dbang po'i gzhu// utpal dmar po rnams kyis bskus/ ༈ /bcu bdun pa dga' ba'i rgyan gcig go// khyod lus dkar 'jam reg bya'i rol rtsed la// bdag gis cung zad reg pa'i bde dga' 'di// khyod kyis slar yang reg na dga' ba dang*// bde ba de dag 'phel zhing gzhan du min/ ༈ /bco brgyad pa nyams ldan las/ dang po sgeg pa'i nyams ldan/ khyod gdong 'dzum stong 'jo sgeg gi// rnam 'gyur 'di mthong ngo cag kyang*// yid kyi padmo rab brtas pas// lus kyi rol rtsed yid srub bo// gnyis pa drag shul/

dge la sems pa gang khyod kyis// mi dge spyod pa dag mthong na// gtum rngam khro gnyer sprin bsdus nas// sdang mig tshig rtsub me char 'bebs// gsum pa dpa' ba/ lang tsho rgyas pa'i gzhon nu ma// 'bum phrag tshogs kyang khyod nyid kyi// mig zur tsam gyis rab btab pas// mdza' tshugs khol po nyid du byas// bzhi pa snying rje/ da lta mig 'dzum tshad tsam du// 'bral ba'ang dka' ba 'o cag gnyis// nam zhig sgyu lus 'jig pa'i chos// ro khang sreg za'i nang du nyal// lnga pa mi sdug pa/ zhib mor brtags na snying sdug khyod// rnag khrag khu ba srin 'bu dang*// bshang gci'i rdzas kyis gang ba'i snod// sred pa spel la dga' 'di mtshar// drug pa bzhad gad nyams// snying grogs gnyis skyes gzhon nu khyod// 'dod ldan grogs po dang brtses pa'i// mchu yi so rjes gsar pa de// sor mos dbyi ba brjed ngas sam// bdun pa rmad byung*/ khyod lus reg bya ro 'dzin dag /lha yi gos dang sbrang rtsi'i ros// bdag lus 'jam bdes bde ba dang*/ bdud rtsi'i ro yis yid dga' 'phel// brgyad pa 'jigs rung rnams so// 'dod pa'i 'ching bas bcings pa'i gzhon nu dag /nam zhig lnga par gyur tshe gshin rje yi// pho nyas rgyob sod sgra yi ku co dang*/ mtshon chas gtub tshe khyod kyis byar yod dam/ ༈ /bcu dgu pa gzi brjid can rgyan gcig go// gnyis skyes 'di la 'dod sred spyad rnams kyi// mthu ldan bdag gis 'joms zhes dngangs mi bdog /gna' dus spyod pa de ko deng spangs na// bdag gi sems kyang khro ba'i lang tsho zhi/ ༈ /nyi shu pa rnam grangs brjod pa rgyan gcig go// gnyis skyes khyod sems mdza' ba yi// grogs shig gal te yod pa na// re zhig de dang rtser mdzod cig /'o cag don gnyis slar 'ong ngo*/ ༈ /nyer gcig pa kun tu phan pa'i rgyan yang gcig go// snying la rtsen pa'i grogs de dran pa las// mngon 'dod gsar pa'i tshad gdung 'phel ba'i tshe// sngo bsangs chu 'dzin lang long rab dkrigs nas// ga pur bsil ba'i sbrang char dal gyis bab/

༈ /nyer gnyis pa rgya che ba'i rgyan las/ dang po bsam pa rgya che ba/ nyi mas rgyu skar ji bzhin du// gzhon nu gzhan rnams zil gnon khyod// g.yem dang dgod bag gsog gsog dang*// lang tshos dregs med dbang po dul// gnyis pa 'byor ba rgya che ba'o// lus phra khyod kyis bka' rtags gos// rnam gsum thun mtshams gzhon nu dag /tshong zong gzhal bar mi spyod na// gos rgyan gzhan rnams lta ci smos/ ༈ /nyer gsum pa bsnyon dor gyi rgyan las/ dang po ngo bo bsnyon dor/ gnyis skyes khyod gdong 'dzum pa'i thig phreng 'di// 'dzum bzhad ma yin yid 'ching zhags pa nyid// zur mig g.yo ba'i rol gar mig zur dag /ma yin bdag snying 'bigs pa'i nyag phran nyid// gnyis pa yul la/ gzhon nu bdag la 'khyud pa'i lag pa yis// dam por bcings pa 'di ko lcags sgrog nyid// yid kyi gdung ba med la lag pa 'di| |'ching byed srad bu'i tshul yang min par nges// gsum pa rang bzhin/ khyod dang legs par 'grogs pa'i rtsed 'jo 'di// dga' bde chags pa'i snying por bdag 'dod kyang*// yud tsam bral yang mi dga' skyed byed pas// dga' skyid snying po de ko ga la yin// bzhi pa dpe'i bsnyon dor ro// rnam par g.yo zhing 'khrugs pa'i 'gyur ldog dang*// chu yi phreng ba 'dzag pa'i sprin gzhon dang*| |gnyis skyes khyod gdong rtag par dkar zhing 'dzum// mdzes pa 'di ni ci slad mtshungs par gyur/ ༈ /nyer bzhi pa sbyar ba'i rgyan las/ dang po gcod mtshams tha dad min pa'i sbyar ba/ dmar ser 'dab ma phang phung can// mtsho ngogs dga' ba'i rol rtsed dang*// mgrin pa'i rdza rnga snyan sgrog pa// gnyis skyes bdag yid dga' ba'i dpal// gnyis pa gcod mtshams tha dad pa/ rab rgyas dkar ba'i mdangs dang ldan// mtshan mar bcas pa'i lang tsho ngom// 'dzum 'od stong phrag bzhad pa'i dpal// dkar gsal mdzes pas tsha gdung skyob// gsum pa dpe/

rin chen rgyan mang gis brgyan cing*// mdzes sdug lang tsho rab rgyas pa// gnyis skyes rol gar sgyur ba khyod// skabs gsum grong gi gar mkhan sdang*// bzhi pa gzugs can/ rab snyan rna ba'i bcud len nyid| |sgra snyan stong phrag gis phyug pa'i// yid kyi skyo ba sangs byed pa// lus can kun gyi snying gi dpal// lnga pa 'gog pa/ 'dzum phreng bdag nyid rab dkar zhing*// dal bu dal bus rab 'char ba'i// khyod gdong zla ba 'di yod tshe// zla ba phal pas ci zhig bya// drug pa ldog pa/ dri zhim 'byung gnas khyod kyi lus// 'dab ma rab rgyas nyid dang mtshungs// gser ldan can gyi dpal gyur pas// 'di yi mtshungs pa nyid kyang min// bdun pa bya ba tha dad min pa/ dmar ser mdzes pa'i 'dab ldan can// dri bzhon la ni rab brten pa// gzhon nus mngon 'dod gdung ba sel| |chu khur gyis kyang tsha gdung skyob// brgyad pa bya ba 'gal min/ gnyis skyes dmar ser 'dab ldan la// mgrin snyan zlos gar 'phrul ba dag /ngang pa'i sgra ni thos pa dang*// myos ldan de yis 'khyud pa dag /dgu pa 'gal ba'i las/ dben pa'i lang tsho rab dpa' ba'i// yid 'phrog mdza' bo rab gzhar ba// phal pa de ko rab 'jungs kyi// gzhon nu khyod ni g.yar ldan no// bcu pa sbyar ba'i nges can/ khyod lus mdzes pa'i 'dab ldan ni// bag yod bka' rtags kho na ste// lang tsho bde ba'i gar mkhan yang*// gnyis skyes yin gyi sgro ldan min// bcu gcig pa nges pa 'gog pa/ khyod gdong smin legs g.yo ba dag /'jo sgeg yin gyi ltag chod min// 'on kyang nyes ltung bag yangs su// spyod pa mthong na de la khro// bcu gnyis pa 'gal med/ lus med la ni rab brten cing*| |thun mtshams g.yo ba'i 'dab ma can// gnyis skyes gzhon nu nyid nges kyang*// 'o mtshor rgyu ba'i ngang pa'ang de// bcu gsum pa gang rung ba 'gal zhing cig shos la mi 'gal ba'i sbyar ba rnams so// mtshams sprin 'dab ma rab g.yo yang*// mtsho ngogs rdzing bur mi 'jug cing*// gya gyu'i 'gros kyis rab sgeg kyang*// lce gnyis dug gi zer mi spro/

༈ /nyer lnga pa khyad par brjod pa'i rgyan las/ dang po yon tan ma tshang ba'i khyad par brjod pa/ mdza' bo khyod gdong 'dzum pa'i zhags pa la// zur mig lcags kyus spras 'di sra ba dang*// ring zhing rno ngar 'khyogs pa mi ldan yang*| |btab pa tsam gyis bdag yid bcings shing bkug /gnyis pa rigs ma tshang ba/ grogs khyod sum rtsen dbang po'i rigs min zhing*// gdengs can dga' ma'i mngal nas ma bskrun kyang*// lus can kun yid 'gugs pa'i lang tsho dang*// sred ldan tshim byed 'dzum stong phyogs brgyar spel// gsum pa bya ba ma tshang ba/ zur mig g.yo dang 'dzum 'od dra ba dang*// gar gyis rtsen pa'i lag gis ma 'khyud kyang*// lus med bde ba'i skye dgu 'di ko rnams// tshim byed snga na med pa khyod min su// bzhi pa rdzas ma tshang ba/ tsandan til mar gyis sbags sreg za dang*// sgro brgya ldan pa'i mārgag ṇa med kyang*// gzhon nu khyod mthong bdag snying mngon 'dod kyi// tsha bas gdungs shing kun nas 'bigs par nus// lnga pa rgyu'i khyad par brjod pa rnams so// zhi dul bag dang ldan zhing g.yar tsha ba'i| |nor gyis rab phyug gzhogs stegs kun spangs kyang*// 'bad med 'dzum brgyas spras pa'i lang tsho 'dis// bdag yid dga' spro gsar pa'i dpal du byas/ ༈ /nyer drug pa mtshungs sbyor gyi rgyan las/ dang po bstod pa'i mtshungs sbyor/ ri dwags gzugs ldan bsil zer dang*// gser gyis spras pa'i so gnyis pa// sgeg 'chang mtshams sprin gzhon nu ma// gnyis skyes khyod rnams 'jig rten rgyan| |gnyis pa smad pa dag go// bdag yid 'ching ba'i grogs khyod dang*// 'dab rtse'i chu dang glog gi gar// dbang po'i 'khyog ldan dbu ba'i phreng*// lang tsho bde yang lnga par gyur/ ༈ /nyer bdun pa 'gal ba'i rgyan las/ dang po gzhi tha dad pa'i bya ba 'gal ba/ chu shel dbang po 'dzum 'od phreng spel tshe// ku mud rgyas kyang bdag cag 'od gsal 'jug

/khyod gdong 'dzum 'od zer phreng spros pa'i tshe// ngo cag yid kyi padmo kun nas rgyas// gnyis pa gzhi tha dad kyi yon tan 'gal ba/ mdzes pa khyod kyi 'jo sgeg rnam 'gyur gyis// dpag yas 'dzum stong gar gyi rol rtsed dag /mthong tshe chags ldan dga' bde'i gter thob kyang*// khrims ldan ba spu g.yo ba'ang ci phyir ldog /gsum pa gzhi tha dad kyi rdzas 'gal ba/ smin legs nag cing 'khyogs la dpral dbyes drang*/ sked skabs phra zhing lte ba'i bum pa sbom// mthong byed nag cing mchu sgros dmar ba'i mdangs// mdzes ldan khyod kyis mi tshim lus can su// bzhi pa rdzas dang las 'gal ba/ bzhin ras shar gyi thig le 'od dkar g.yo// 'phrul mthing mig gi utpal lang tsho ngom// so phreng kha ba'i sa 'dzin tshar du dngar// de dag kun gyis bdag yid sreg zas gdung*// lnga pa gzhi gcig pa'i bya ba 'gal ba/ mdza' bo khyod kyi 'jo sgeg rol gar gyis// zhar la 'phangs pa'i zur mig nyag phran de// skyes bus 'khyog ldan lam du ma drangs kyang*// sred ldan snying gi 'ben la lan brgyar bsnun// drug pa gzhi gcig gi rdzas 'gal ba rnams so// dkar nag dmar ba'i tshon brgyas rab bkra ba'i// mdzes byed mig gi ā laṅkā ra can// khro 'dzum rnam 'gyur g.yo ba'i gar mkhan kwe// gnyis skyes khyod kyis bdag yid bas par byas/ ༈ /nyer brgyad pa skabs min 'gyod pa'i rgyan gcig kho nar zad do// 'dus byas bdag gir mi 'dzin par// rnyed sla'i chu dang shing thog gi// nags khrod bde ba'i dben pa bsten| |ri dwags 'di ko rmad du byung*/ ༈ /nyer dgu pa zol bstod kyi rgyan las/ dang po zla bo'i zol bstod/ nag po brtsegs pa'i che zhe'i lang tsho dang*// dpal mo'i bde sogs gangs ri'i bu mo yis// 'dzum phreng des kyang bdag yid dga' skyed de// khyod kyis bdag yid tshim la dregs mi 'tshal// gnyis pa sbyar ba'i zol/

bram ze'i khye'ur gyur pa karma yis// ma rnying lang tsho gsar pa'i 'dzum phreng de// 'bad pa med par phrogs nas bdag gi bar// mdzad de gnyis skyes khyod kyis dbyar mi rigs// gsum pa dpa' ba'i zol/ gang gis mthong dang 'grogs pa'i lus can dag /dga' bde gsar pa'i rnam par g.yeng ba yis// nam yang ngal ba med par spyod pa 'di// grogs khyod bdag cag g.yeng ba'i rgyu las ci/ ༈ /sum cu pa nges bstan gyi rgyan las/ dang po mchog /lha dbang lus kyi snang brnyan dag /bai ḍūr gzhi la rtag 'char ba// mdza' bo khyod kyi bzhin ras dag /bdag yid 'char ba nges par mtshon// gnyis pa mchog min/ lo 'dab lang tsho mdzes snang yang*// bi ṣa'i rkang 'thung zug rngu'i rgyu// ma rnying lang tsho can khyod kyi// 'dod ltung nyes pa nges mtshon snyam/ ༈ /so gcig pa lhan gcig brjod pa'i rgyan las/ dang po yon tan lhan cig brjod pa/ khyod gdong lang tsho rab rgyas g.yo ba dang*// pad dkar phang phung rgyas pa lhan cig bkra// ma ma ta wa dzi hwa gzhibs pa dang*// rkang drug sbrang rtsi btung ba lhan cig bda'// gnyis pa bya ba tha dad pa'i lhan cig brjod pa// khyod bzhin mig gi mtshan ma bkra ba dang*// bsil zer ri bong gzugs dag lhan cig nyid// zur mig 'dzum gyis bdag snying brtas pa dang*// bsil phreng ku mud spel ba lhan cig byas// gsum pa bya ba gcig pa'i lhan cig brjod pa/ kasmī ra yul gur gum brtas pa dang*// ston ka'i mtshams sprin dmar ser g.yo ba dang*// btso ma'i ri dbang nyi zer gyis reg pa// gzhon nu khyod kyi gos rnams lhan cig mdzes/ ༈ /so gnyis pa yongs brjes kyi rgyan gcig go// bdag mig bhra ma raḥ'adi ko// khyod gdong padmar rab zhugs tshe// de yi 'dzum dkar zla ba'i zer// bdag snying 'o mtshor 'phros dga' 'phel/ ༈ /so gsum pa shis brjod kyi rgyan gcig go/ mdzes ldan khyod dang 'o cag lhan cig tu// mngon 'dod bde ba'i dpal yon la rol pa'i// mchog dbang gsum pa'i ting 'dzin myur grub nas// tshig dbang don gyi ye shes mchog 'grub smon/

༈ /so bzhi pa rab spel gyi rgyan gcig go// kunda ltar dkar khyod bzhin gyi// zur mig glog gi gar bzhin mdzes| |mchu dmar padma rā ga yang*// mdzes pas lha dbang skyengs zhes thos/ ༈ /so lnga pa dgongs pa can gyi rgyan yang gcig go// thogs med blo gros nam mkha'i khyon yangs par// blo ldan zla ba bdag gi legs bshad kyi// zer phreng stong phrag g.yo ba 'di spros pas// lha sras thugs kyi ku mud deng nas brtas// zhes snyan ngag me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam bung ba'i rol rtsed ngag gi 'dod 'jo sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba las// don rgyan so lnga pa las 'phros pa'i dper brjod dbye ba sho lo ka nyis brgya dang bcu bzhi'i grangs su gnas pa ste sarga dang po'o// ༈ //gnyis pa sgra rgyan bshad pa la// bya ba'i dngos rnams sla ba dang*// dka' ba dag gi brjod bya yi// bar ma chod dang bar chod dag /yi ge'i tshogs pa skor ba na// zung ldan de yang rkang pa yi// dang po bar mtha'i spyod yul can// zhes pa ltar/ dper brjod rim par bya ba la gsum/ dbyangs gsal nges pa'i bya dka' ba// rjes khrid/ zung rgyan no// dang po la/ a yig /nags na gnas pa tsa nakṣa// dpa' rnams dga' ba gar mkhas pas// chags ldan dga' ba rab brtas pa// lha sras dag la chags pa kwa/ i yig /mi yi srid 'di smin yid 'dzin/ u yig /dus su 'phrul rgyun mu ru suḥ /e yig /bde chen ye shes cher spel te// o yig /mngon 'dod bcom mo grogs po khyod/ gsal byed// ka pu ra rtul bsil phreng kā shi ka// kha ba'i mdangs ldan sa phreng ro 'dzin kha// ga zhe dang 'grogs brtses pa 'di ci ga /nga yi srid pa bcom mo 'dod ldan nga*// rjes khrid ni/ kye ma snying gi grogs khyod gson dang snying brtse'i sems kyis bdag la sems// sems ldan khyod 'dod gsar pa 'phel gyi 'dod pa 'di ko chags ldan dga'// dga' ma'i bzhin ras rab dmar mdangs kyis rab rtsen ngo cag spu long g.yo// g.yo ldan 'jo sgeg gar gyi rol pas gar mkhas ma khyod mdzes so kye// 'dod la 'chums pa'i g.yo can ma// ma ma khyod bzhin dmar ba'i mig

/mig zur zhags pa 'phangs pa na// na ra'i tshogs rnams de rtser 'dod// zung ldan las/ dang po thog ma'i zung ldan bar chod pa/ rab mdzes rab tu dben pa yi// na chung na ra'i me tog khyod// lha rigs lha las bab pa ste| |bdag 'dod bdag yid tshim par mdzod// gnyis pa bar gyi zung ldan bar chod pa/ gnyis skyes mdzes pa mdzes ldan ni// lang tsho rab dga' rab dpa' bas// 'dod ldan rtse dga' brtse ba'i phyir| |mngon 'dod gsar pa gsar du spel// gsum pa tha ma'i zung ldan bar chod pa/ blo ldan bung ba bde byed bde// gshog yangs dkar po'i rol rtsed rol// rnam pa thams cad 'dod can 'dod| |rab skyes mngon 'dod brtse phyir rtse// bzhi pa thog dbus chod pa/ legs par legs pa'i rab mdzes rab dga' ma// mngon 'dod mngon par spel ba spel mdzad des// bdag yid bdag la mi dga' mi gzhan yang*// rab rtse rab tu dga' ba'i dga' ston byas// lnga pa dbus mtha' chod pa/ rigs bzang lha mi lha dbang lha yi lha// gang khyod lha ldan zhing nas zhing khams zhing*// gang du sprul pa sku'i gar mkhan gar// bdag yid rnam bkra'i rnam rtsen dga' bdes dga'// drug pa thog ma'i chod pa/ mdzes mdzes gnyis skyes 'dzum phreng gis// de de bzhin du bzhad pa las// gyu gyu'i snyan tshig phreng ba yang*// kyur kyur glu dbyangs e ma mtshar// bdun pa bar ma'i chod pa/ khyod kyi snyan snyan tshig phreng gis// bdag yid rtsub rtsub g.yo ba dang*// bsam gtan sgom 'phro 'phro can du// bzhag nas rtse rtse 'jo sgeg bas// brgyad pa tha ma'i chod pa/ mdzes par sems pa'i lus de de// bdag la g.yo ba'i gar mkhas mkhas// kha sgo las thon tshig snyan snyan// bdag yid nam du'ang rab g.yo g.yo// dgu pa thog dbus ma chod pa/ yang yang sems pa dung dung ma byas kyang*// gang gang yid gcugs mdza' mdza'i grogs rnams kyi// mkhas mkhas tshig don don ldan de bsam na// bde bde la rol rol rtsed la lags so// bcu pa dbus mtha' ma chod pa/

bzhin ras rab mdzes mdzes ma'i bzhin 'dzum 'dzum// glu dbyangs snyan snyan lag pa'i gar khyug khyug /gdub kor 'od 'bar 'bar ba'i sems chags chags// rnam dpyod 'jo sgeg sgeg mo'i sbyor bde bde// bcu gcig pa thog dbus sbyar ba/ sa steng 'di na sa yi bdag /mi dbang chen po mi yi dpal// gong mar gyur pa gong ma che// na ra ha sya na ra'i gtso// bcu gnyis pa dbus mtha' sbyar ba/ srid gsum rgyal ba bdud las rgyal// grags pa mchog 'bar dpal 'byor 'bar// bsod nams stobs rgyas de srid rgyas// bcu gsum pa zlog pa// mdzes pa dam pas 'gro ba bde/ bde bar 'gro bas dam pa mdzes// mdzes pa rgyal ba'i gsung rab dge// dge rab gsungs pa'i rgyal ba mdzes// bcu bzhi pa rgyun chags/ gang gang rgyal ba'i gsung rab rab dge thub rnams dgyes pa'i dam chos chos// brtse brtse thugs bskyed rgya cher cher 'phags 'gro la sman pa'i theg chen che// yang yang gsungs pas 'di don don ldan 'o cag bsam gtan 'di sgom sgom// bas bas 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal bsngal las da ni ngo cag rgyab phyogs phyogs// bco lnga pa chen po/ gang gi gzhon nu gang dang gang*// gang yin gang de 'grogs tshe gang*// gang 'dod gang chags 'jo sgeg gang*// gang spyad gang de su zhig gang*// bcu drug pa ched du 'khor ba/ blo gros blo ldan kho bo yi// blo gsal blo mtsho las thon pa'i// snyan ngag snyan pa'i gtam snyan 'di// snyan ngag mkhas 'dod mkhas par slobs// bcu bdun pa kun tu bzang po/ mdzes ma rab mdzes mig yangs ma// mdzes pa'i zur mig mdzes ldan ma// mdzes pa'i 'jo sgeg mdzes ston ma// mdzes pa de ni mdzes 'dzoms ma// bco brgyad pa ba lang gcig/ blo ldan skye bo yid kyi dpal// blo gsal skye bo yid srung dpal// dpal ldan mdzes pa'i mthu thob blo// dpal gnas legs bshad kho bo'i blo// bcu dgu pa gzugs gcig pa/

slob dpon daṇḍi'i me long dag /dag por slob dpon de lugs bzhin// bzhin gsal me long tshig gi rgyan// dag por daṇḍi'i legs bshad spel// nyi shu pa gzugs tha dad pa/ snyan ngag mkhas dbang dbang po'i legs bshad 'di// 'di ni legs bshad dbang phyug ngag sgra snyan// snyan tshig blo mtsho blo yi spyod yul mkhan// mkhan po 'di ko 'di rtsom byed po dang*// gzhan yang me long las/ kun tu dbye ba las skyes pa// de dag dbye ba shin tu mang*| |zhes zung ldan la rgyan shin tu mang bar gsungs mod/ 'on kyang sla ba dang dka' ba sogs zhal 'phangs mdzad pa rnams 'dir ma bris te grags che ba'i phyir shes par sla la/ 'dir ni gzhung dngos bstan gyi bya dka' ba'i gnas rnams smras pa'o// zhes snyan ngag me long gi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam bung ba'i rol rtsed ngag gi 'dod 'jo sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba las/ sgra rgyan dngos bstan rnams yongs su dpyad de bshad pa sho lo ka nyi shu'i grangs su gnas pa ste sarga gnyis pa'o// ༈ //gsum pa gab tshig ni daṇḍis/ gab tshig dag gi rnam pa yi// lugs kyang rab tu bstan par bya// rtsed mo'i 'dun sar bzhad gad dang*// de shes tshogs su gsang smra dang*// pha rol kun tu rmongs byed la// gab tshig dag ni nyer mkhor ldan// zhes gsungs rgyan gyi rnam grangs kyang*/ de nyid las/ 'di dag gab tshig bcu drug ste// sngon gyi slob dpon rnams kyis bstan// zhes gnas dang po la bcu drug dang*/ yang de nyid las/ gab tshig ngan pa gzhan dag kyang*// bcu bzhi de dag rnams kyis brjod// ngan pa mtshan nyid med gang de// skyon gyi dngos bgrang bya min par// rig nas slar yang bdag cag gis// legs pa kho na brjod par bya// zhes gnas gnyis pa la bcu bzhi gsungs pa las/ gnas dang po bcu drug ni/ dper na/ dang po kun tu tshogs pa/ sa la rab rtse dri za'i bu mo gser gyi ni// phreng ba sgra 'chang rab tu dga' ba'i bzhin rab tu// sbed byed ma de sngo bsangs thun mtha'i bsam pa ni// brtan po'i ting 'dzin 'thob slad gzhon nu rnams kyi nyer spyad 'os// gnyis pa slu byed/

mkha' la skar ma'i tshogs rab bkra// sa 'dir chu skyes lang tsho ngom// grul bum dga' ma mig sman can// 'dod ldan dga' ma'i 'jo sgeg rol// gsum pa rim pa bral ba/ dal gyis 'bab pa'i rdzing bu'i ngogs// mig sman me tog bkra ba dang*// ngang mo gser ldan dga' skyed ces// de 'dra de dag de rjes 'jug /bzhi pa rab bcom/ rab brjid da chu'i lhun po brtsegs pa'i ngogs// glang chen 'gros 'dra'i ri dbang zung ldan pa'i// nags 'dab dben pa'i phug tu rab brtse ba'i// dbang phyug lto 'phye'i gar 'di e ma rmad// lnga pa mthun gzugs/ gang gi nyer spyad pa yi sprin sngon ni// dam gyis rtse ba ma smad phul byung dbang*// rnam bkra lha yi rgyud mang gis rtsen na// sred ldan dga' bder longs spyod 'di ci ga /drug pa rtsub pa/ gangs ri'i thigs pa rmad byung ba// rab dga' dgos ma'i rgyun gyis dben// de dag 'dod ldan rnams kyi sdig /grags pa phul byung dbang du phyug /bdun pa grangs nyid/ zla ba'i mgo ldan ri dwags gdong*// 'khrig pa'i mig can so skyes kyi// ze'u 'brur ldan pa'i padma las// ma gzhibs na yang sbrang rtsi spyod// brgyad pa rab btags/ dben pa'i gnas su tsa ko ra| |bde bar nyal zhing bde bar rgyu// bsil ba'i ma la ya rlung las// lha min bu mos 'khyud cing thob// dgu pa ming du ma 'dus pa/ kau shi ka yi sa nā taḥ ring du gnas pa'i yid srub dang*// skra 'dres dri za'i na chung ma// sil sil sgra ldan la 'khyud do// bcu pa bsgribs pa/ 'dab ldan gnyis skyes mtshams sprin gyi// du kū la 'changa'adi ko dag /snang ba ka tsa lindā na// ku tu binda'i rdzu bag 'chang*// bcu gcig pa mthun pa/ mkha' la rgyu ba'i ka damba// myos pa'i sgra ldan mig dmar zhing*// gser mngal can gyi blo gros dgra// grags pa khams gsum khongs su g.yo// bcu gnyis pa rmongs pa/

dbyar tha'i phyi ma la bab tshe// mkha' chu dri med yi gar 'ong*// kye ma 'bad pa'i longs spyod dag /rab tu 'dus so yid dga' ma// bcu gsum pa yongs 'phrog /gangs ri'i dbang po'i gos ldan lha min dgra /rnam bkra dri za'i rgyud mang glu dbyangs kyis// nyer spyad dri med dal 'gro'i 'bab stegs ni// sum rtsen ar mo nig ka'i gor ma snyam// bcu bzhi pa gcig sgrib/ sa 'dzin ji lta'i lhun po brtsegs pa'i rtser// rab dga' tshangs pa'i grong yang zil gnon pa'i// khang brtsegs yid 'ong stong phrag khyim gyis bskor// rmad byung 'di ko bsod nams phul gyi grong*// bco lnga pa gnyis ka bsgribs pa/ ma la ya rtse chos kyis mtho ba'i mkhar// gzha' tshon bdag po'i gar gyi sgyu ma nyid// rnam pa sna tshogs dge ba'i tshogs las bskrun// mig dang rna ba'i bcud len yin zhes gleng*// bcu drug pa yongs 'dres rnams so// mkha' la rab rgyu lag 'gro phru ma'i gar// rab yangs lam du gar gyis 'phye ba dang*// 'phrul lding 'phrog byed mdza' mo'i nā di kaḥ e ma mtshar sdug snying gi lcags kyu nyid// ces pa rnams te/ de dag rnams ni me long las// tshig mtshams sbyar bas don sbas pa// zhes pa nas/ de ni yongs su 'dres zhes bya// zhes rgyan so so'i mtshan nyid gsungs pa la dpyad de bkod pa yin la/ yang gzhung las/ ma ya go ro sems kyi ni// zhes pa nas/ 'di ni yi ge shes kyang blun// zhes pa'i bar so sor dper brjod mdzad pa la dpyad de bkod pa ni 'di lta ste/ dang po kun tu tshogs pa/ mai na ka tsa snying gi ni// 'dus shes med la ci slad khro// gnas ma yin par cho nge yis// bgyi ba ci yod mig dmar ma// gnyis pa slu byed/ rnam med mthong ba khyod kho nas// bde dga' 'phel ba ci zhig gu// a ma ra ṇar co 'dri ba// gzhon nu spyad pa de ci ga /gsum pa rim pa bral ba/ rkang par 'o byed 'dab can gyi// ngang pa tsher rtsub lang tsho can// gdong la glu dbyangs sgrog ldan ma// de lus 'dar zhing 'chus par byed// bzhi pa rab bcom/

skra 'dres ma khyod yugs sa yi// gdu bu rab rgyas sil sil sgra// lkog gyur spangs pa kho na 'dir// bdag gi tshe ni brtan ma yin// lnga pa gzugs mthun/ rnam rgyas yar 'dab g.yo ba'i rtser// 'dab ldan snum pa'i dog pa 'chang*// lcug phran lnga pa zla ba'i thod// bdag gi skyed mos tshal 'di mthong*// drug pa rtsub mo/ lus med lus med khang pa ru// mche ba'i mdangs kyis dal bur rgyu// dri ldan rdzing bur myos byas pa// de de de rnams da rgas bzhin// bdun pa grangs nyid/ nga sogs lnga ldan dbus su ni// gsal ba bzhis brgyan des brgyan pa'i// pho brang 'ga' yod gang zhig na// mi bdag mdog mig brgyad can yod| |brgyad pa rab btags/ lus kun rab tu 'khrul ba dang*// yan lag mchog dud mig sman pa// sdod kyang 'dar ldan kho bo la// na tshod gtugs pa rjes rtsen nam// dgu pa ming 'dus pa/ mthong byed mi brtan nor 'dzin 'ga'// thog mar rgyal po zhes smra sgrog /g.yung drung rgyal po de min gyi// rtul mo'i bu yang de min no// bcu pa bsgribs pa/ longs spyod dman mi de btang nas// nor ldan de ko 'phye ba gang*// 'jig rten 'gugs slad sna tshogs brgya// bzung bza' skra 'dres ma de ko// bcu gcig pa mthun pa/ sa min ming la mthu mnyam khyod// gang gi skra min can las 'khu| |rab ldan des deng 'u 'u cag /sred ldan byas so tshig snyan ma// bcu gnyis pa rmongs pa/ 'chums ldan dag gi mal khri la// sdang bas rab bzlog der zhugs gyur// chags pas de de ltar 'dug pa// dal gyi tsumba na dag kwa// bcu gsum pa yongs 'phrog /gnyis skyes rgyal po zas ldan dgra// gong ma'i 'od phreng gis 'dir bcom// de grogs de min de 'dzin pa// mkha' khyab mngon dga'i kau bidyāḥ /bcu bzhi pa gcig bsgribs pa/ gang yang na ri shāst+ra syaḥ /dkar 'dzin dkyil 'khor ma reg na'ang*// a ma nu pa 'ga' 'ga' zhig

/sug pa 'di 'dras med min lo// bco lnga pa gnyis bsgribs pa/ gang dag su zhig de 'grogs pa'i// bya ba de ko nye bar ni// legs thob bza' bas rtag par yang*// gal te de mthong de 'dod byed// bcu drug pa yongs 'dres rnams so// so ldan dpa' bo cang shes kyi// sde 'di rgyal bar ma gyur na// ma ma dus med de yi bu// 'dis ni rig pa shes kyang blun// zhes pa rnams so// gnas gnyis pa la gzhung du cung zad smad nas dper brjod ma gsungs mod/ 'on kyang blo gros kyi nor dang ldan tshe gzhung du gnas phyi ma sa bcad tsam gsungs pa de dag kyang khyad gzhi snga ma kho na ltar la khyad chos tha dad du ston pa nyid rigs pa'i phyir/ 'di skad du/ 1 ma la ya skyed tshal rab tu// mdzes pa'i sna ldan dal 'gro ma// 'dod pa 'dod la 'chums pa'i dug /sred med rnams la de sman no| 2 /shel dkar lcug phran yal 'dab bcu pa'i rtser// byu ru'i me tog lang tsho g.yo ldan gyis// bskyod pa'i ngang mo 'dar ba de'i rnga sgras// dri za'i na chung mig nas 'chi ma 'dzag 3 /mu tig 'khri shing gzhon nu la// brtan g.yo'i gzha' tshon gyis 'khyud pa// bdag la g.yo ba'i zlos gar dang*// snyan tshig mgrin pa'i drug skyes thos/ 4 /gang gi mngon 'dod gsar pa yi// ga pur 'dzag pa'i thigs phreng 'dzin// dri bzhon dal bu dal bu yis/ reg na bde ba e ma mtshar/ 5 /'dab stong bzhad pa'i tshal rab rmad byung dga' skyed lang tsho ci yang g.yo| |lcug phran gzhon nu rengs par bskyod pa'i gar mkhan ni tsu makta kaḥ /'dir shog 'dir bzhugs mgrin pa'i rdza rnga drug skyes mes po'i rna bar snyan// phung phung 'dab ma'i gdugs dkar g.yogs pas mngon 'dod rtse dga' 'di dṛṣṭaḥ 6 /gang na na chung mdzes ma yi// sug pa'i 'og pag dir dir sgra// mkha' la dri bzhon gyis bskyod pa'i// sprin sngon dal 'gro kho bos mthong*|

7 /kai la sha las thon pa'i rgyun// dal gyis 'gro yang myur bar shes// 'bab stegs ga ma gar 'khyil ba'i// dbu ba'i phreng ba do shal ngom/ 8 /kye ma tsandan nags su bdag |gtsug phud can gyi mai na kaḥ /gza' yi bdag po der 'phos pa'i// gzi 'od ga pur thigs pa 'dzin/ 9 /ṛkṣa ṇya rlung dang ldan pa'i// padma dkar po lang tsho ngom// sbrang rtsi bung ba'i nyer spyad 'os// dri zhim de de de ko su/ 10 /'char ba la gnas ngang pa mo// mgrin pa'i rdza rnga du kū laḥ /sa gsum srid ldan yid g.yo ba// dga' ba ma yin e ma mnar/ 11 /zla ba 'pho ba'i na chung ma// spyod pa rtsen pa'i zlos gar yid// gar mkhan sgyu ma bzang mo kye// skar ma'i do shal phrogs min nam/ 12 /mkha' la rgyu ba'i ga pur can gyi rdul// ma smad khor yug ri bo'i khongs su yang*// mdzes ma'i grags rnga tsandan sa mchog thig /lag 'gro tsha ba'i gdung bcil gzhan su zhig 13 /gang du lha min dbang po'i sgra// khang brtsegs bdag po de gzhan zhig /de yod phyir na de yang de'i// rjes 'gro yin no gzhan yang de/ 14 /khor yug ri bo'i khongs yang skyed tshal shel dkar ni tsu la pang du// 'dab ldan dga' ba'i gar mkhan mchog nyid nyi zla'i thod can do shal ngom// drug skyes rgyud mang dal gyis sbrengs ba'i rnga sgra nam mkha'i khongs su spa// srid 'dir mi dman dga' bde la rol sum rtsen ming gi lhag mar byas// 'di dag ni phyogs phyi ma la blo gros kyi dpyad pas yongs su dpyad nas sbyor tshul rigs pa'i rnam pa du mas gzhung gi dgongs don dpyis phyin pa nyid legs par bshad pa'i lam du drangs pa'o// zhes pa snyan ngag me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam bung ba'i rol rtsed ngag gi 'dod 'jo sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba las/ gab tshig gi rgyan gyi dngos dang zhar bstan rnams gsal por phye ba dper brjod zhe drug tu rnam par dbye ba ste sarga gsum pa'o// smras pa/

gang gi rgyal ba'i tshogs kun mkhyen brtse mtha' dag 'doms pa ji snyed shes bya'i go 'byed ngos// 'jam dbyangs 'jam pa'i rdo rje zhes grags nam mkha'i nor bu mtshams sprin li khri'i thig phreng 'dzin// ji lta ji snyed dngos dang dngos min mtha' dag yang dag khyod blor chub pa'i 'od stong gis// snyan ngag mkhan dbang bdag blo'i pad tshal dus 'dir bdo yi blo gsal rkang drug dga' bar byos/ 1 /lho phyogs chu gter 'jings las thon pa'i tshangs sras legs bshad ri dwags 'dzin// gcig las du ma'i sgyu 'phrul zlos gar ri bong can gzugs yang 'phos pa// bdag blo'i chu snod dang por snang tshe rig lam bcu phrag lang tsho dang*// snyan ngag dbu bas byur bur gtams kyi zeg ma 'di ko yang spros so/ 2 /'jam dbyangs tshangs sras ma sogs legs bshad lha'i// thugs rje blo gros kunda ma bskyangs par// legs bshad sbrang rtsi'i ro rnams kyis dben pas// blo ldan bung ba tshim pa su yi lugs/ 3 /daṇḍi'i tshig rgyan chu mtsho las// ded dpon tsarya'i bgrod pa yis// legs bshad nor bu rab blangs nas// blo ldan slob ma'i rgyal mtshan rtser/ 4 /'bad pas bkod de sbyangs stobs kyis// gsol ba btab las dgos don rnams// 'bad med 'byung gi de tshul las// ldog pa'i blun po'i rdzun rib kyis/ 5 /snyan ngag mkhan dbang go 'phang mchog /bgrod rlom grong pa'i a pa nar// wa skyes 'dug dang khyad par ci/ 6 /blo gsal blo gros shel dkar me long 'khrul ba'i dri mas sbags pa dag /blo ldan dzambu nā da'i bum par legs bshad lha yi nyal 'gros gtams// de dag lhag bsam dkar pos drangs te rmongs mun dri ma rab sbyangs nas// shes dang shes bya'i legs bshad lang tsho sgyu ma lta bu de ngor 'char/ 7 /kye ma blo ldan blo'i me long*// mi shes rnyog mas bsgribs pa dag /rmongs blo'i 'jim pa'i bum pa las// byung ba'i chus bkrus slar la rmongs/

8 /sa 'dir rnyed brtson grags pa dag /ma spangs slob dpon ma bsten pa'i// blun po'i dbus kyi snyan ngag mkhan// nga'o zhes pa'i nga ro can/ 9 /de ko daṇḍi'i gzhung lugs la// mkhas pa snga mas legs 'doms pa'i// don rgyan mun pa'i sgron me ltar// gsal por bkral ba de mthong tshe/ 10 /dmus long dmigs bus khrid pa ltar// khyab khyob gya tshom thom 'gros kyis// cung zad tsam zhig rngo thogs tshe// kho bos slob ma bskyangs so lo/ 11 /legs bshad legs par bslabs zhes grags// kho bo snyan ngag mkhan zhes zer| |de tshe bya dka' bya sla dang*// dbyangs dang gsal byed rjes khrid dang*/ 12 /gab tshig rim pa snga phyi sogs// rtogs dka'i legs bshad phul mthong tshe// byis pas lha khang mthong ba ltar| |gtad so med par blo gros rmongs// brag cha ji bzhin nges bzung bral/ 13 /de 'dra'i blo ldan legs bshad mang po'i bang rim ngam pas legs bteg cing*// yin rlom dregs pa'i kha dog bzhi 'chang don la spyod tshe bem por gnas// de la de 'dra'i slob ma'i tshogs dag dug can 'jings bzhin 'khrugs shing 'khor// nyes brgya dug gi na kra la sogs brtse med gdug pas rab gtams pa'i// snyan ngag mkhan dbang lhun po de 'dra sa 'dir shong ba e ma khor yug khongs 'di yangs/ 14 /tshig rgyan lha yi lam yangs por// daṇḍi'i nyi ma de nub kyang*// grags pa'i zla ba deng shar gyi// blo ldan ku mud lan brgyar 'dzum/ 15 /mkhas pa 'dod na mkhas pa bsten// mkhas par bslabs pas mkhas pa 'byung*// mkhas pa des smras mkhas pa 'ga'| |mkhas pa'i go 'phang mkhas pas 'thob/ 16 /kye ma/ rab yangs blo yi go 'byed gsal por rig lam che lnga'i me sbyin dbang po 'od stong 'bar// snyan ngag tshig rgyan sdeb sbyor rtsis sogs rgyu skar bdag po'i lang tsho ngom// de lta'i mthu las bstan bcos gang rnams chu skyes ku mud cher brtas pa'i// legs bshad gzur gnas sbrang rtsi 'di kos blo gsal bung ba tshim par byed/

17 /de ltar smras tshe blun po'i blo// dregs pas gzir rnams phrag dog na'ang*// kho bos tshig gi nyams 'don tsam// byas kyi sdang min de bzod mdzod| 18 /de ltar de brtsams pa yi dge// dkar po dkar gsal zla 'dra ba'i// dge bas dge ba'i tshogs spel zhing*// 'khor bar 'khor rnams 'tshang rgyar shog 19 /legs bshad 'di yang ji srid bar// legs par mi nyams gnas pa dang*// legs pa'i byang chub rgyur smon pa// legs par dus mkhyen rgyal bskal pa bzang po las/ de bzhin gshegs pa dus mkhyen rgyal po ni// snyan ngag mkhan de bde gshegs rtswa mchog la// tshigs su bcad pa'i dbyangs kyis bstod nas kyang*// dang po byang chub mchog tu thugs bskyed do// zhes gsungs pas so// ltar shog 20 /de ltar snyan ngag gi bstan bcos me long gi rgyan gyi dper brjod gzhon nu dga' ba'i gtam bung ba'i rol rtsed ngag gi 'dod pa 'jo ba sarga gsum pa zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'dzin byed kyi lo mṛ ga shi ra zhes chu shel gyi dbang po de'i dga' ma dang rtse ba'i dkar po'i dga' ba gnyis pa la/ 'bri gung skyu ra'i gdung las son pa dbu ru stod kyi snyan ngag mkhan chos kyi grags pa zhes bgyi bas/ gtsug lag lugs gnyis kyi sgo 'phar cig car du 'byed pa'i go sa chen po bye ri stag rnam par rtse ba'i gzhal med khang chen po'i ba gam lnga pa'i re'u mig kun gsal gsang sngags kyi pho brang du legs par dpyad nas sbyar bas yi ge pa ni 'bangs kyi tha shal 'phyongs rgyas pa grags dbang bdag gis so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
